Running worker-control pytest would therefore not validate public SHA 5ab26c5. Pinned same-T two-writer test_runner_single_handoff_stale.py is also absent from public test tree (test-only overlay required). This is a test provenance decision, not a reproduced stale-overwrite failure.
decision.no_network_acceptance: Use disposable checkout pinned by git rev-parse HEAD == 5ab26c5289cb5c4b0480eab3a7c217b2f6ea1431, not worker-control. Materialize approved test-only spawn-safe overlay with sha256. At same as_of_ms T, A pauses only before its anata_latest.json replacement after reading an empty archive; append one unique PIT-valid scoring ETF rowB; B must complete and publish rowB while A is paused.
